title: Ireland Ends National Emergency as Baile an Uisce Outbreak Contained
summary: Taoiseach Seth O’Neill confirms successful operation as Defence Forces prepare to leave affected area
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
# Outbreak Successfully Contained

The Government has announced that the outbreak in Baile an Uisce has been successfully contained following the deployment of the Irish Defence Forces on Friday night.

Taoiseach Seth O’Neill TD confirmed that all individuals identified as carrying the disease have either been detained or eliminated.

He praised the work of the Defence Forces and local authorities, thanking them for their efforts throughout the crisis.


![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565783241720602875/image.png?ex=6ae82307&is=6ae6d187&hm=ccb764e7c7313c316afb9f22ec2ff901d81d2a791a4e880f662544898c58f45a&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=834)



---




# National Emergency Lifted

The Taoiseach has formally ended the National Emergency under the National Emergencies Act.

He also confirmed that he has ordered the Irish Defence Forces to withdraw from Baile an Uisce, ensuring the area is safe before troops leave.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565781012737425578/image.png?ex=6ae820f4&is=6ae6cf74&hm=2e21cfe5969dd2dc603053467ee87efe76e84b53c5c493eec61c10320c52b6bc&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=848)



---





# Threat Level to Be Reduced



The National Threat Level currently remains at Critical. However, the Taoiseach has confirmed that he will put forward a vote to the National Security Council to lower it to Moderate.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565781012737425578/image.png?ex=6ae820f4&is=6ae6cf74&hm=2e21cfe5969dd2dc603053467ee87efe76e84b53c5c493eec61c10320c52b6bc&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=848)



---



# A Message to the Nation

The Taoiseach thanked the Irish public for their patience and cooperation during the emergency, recognising the sacrifices made throughout the crisis.

Concluding his address, he stated:

"*As we exit this crisis, we leave it in the past with our heads held high, a nation with a renewed purpose of national strength and unity.*"

With the outbreak contained and the National Emergency lifted, Ireland begins its return to normality.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565780177680601278/image.png?ex=6ae8202d&is=6ae6cead&hm=877fe0125afb1aa247133ac4034bcb88ebceb0ea747a2a5a99fae033bd18c79d&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=858)

title: Ireland Declares Victory Over Baile an Uisce Outbreak as National Emergency Ends
summary: Taoiseach Seth O’Neill TD confirms successful containment of outbreak as Defence Forces begin gradual withdrawal
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
# A Nation Emerges from Crisis

Following days of uncertainty, fear and emergency operations, the Government has announced that the outbreak in Baile an Uisce has been successfully contained, marking the end of one of the most serious national security crises in recent history.

In a statement delivered to the nation, Taoiseach Seth O’Neill TD confirmed that all individuals identified as carrying the suspected disease had either been detained or eliminated during the joint operation conducted by the Irish Defence Forces, An Garda Síochána and supporting emergency services.

The announcement follows the deployment of elements of the 28th Infantry Battalion and supporting units from 2nd Brigade into Baile an Uisce on Friday night, under direct Government authority.

The operation was launched with the objective of containing the outbreak, securing affected areas and preventing further spread beyond the established military cordon.

Addressing the nation, the Taoiseach said:

"*This week, we have seen and faced, as a nation, a grave danger to our security. On Friday night, the Irish Defence Forces were deployed to Baile an Uisce to assist local authorities in taking down and eradicating the individuals at large and the suspected disease itself.

I can announce to the public that these efforts have been successful, and all individuals identified to have this disease have been detained or eliminated*."

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565780178548818112/image.png?ex=6ae8202d&is=6ae6cead&hm=713271e95223283b6a1627f7e83d96eb0607d9bc9e265b994c2a7f6eca1591e7&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=851)



---



# Defence Forces Operation Declared Successful

he Government has credited the successful containment of the outbreak to the coordinated efforts of the Defence Forces, Gardaí, emergency medical personnel and local authorities.

Throughout the operation, military personnel conducted systematic clearance operations across affected streets and buildings, supported by CBRN-trained specialists responsible for assessing potential contamination and managing the associated risks.

Armoured vehicles, infantry sections, medical teams and engineering personnel were deployed throughout the affected area, maintaining security while allowing emergency services to operate.

The Taoiseach expressed his gratitude to those involved, recognising the commitment and resilience demonstrated by personnel throughout the emergency.

"*It is thanks to the integrity, leadership and resilience shown by local authorities and members of our Defence Forces, and I thank them deeply for their service during this national crisis.*"

He also acknowledged the public's cooperation throughout the emergency, particularly residents who followed Government instructions, observed movement restrictions and avoided the affected area.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565782860697309215/image.png?ex=6ae822ac&is=6ae6d12c&hm=ab5dbbee3d0d3c5331268b3bfa2ada3179be5ef1382a3304d19644e4287f7d3f&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=862)



---



# National Emergency Formally Ended

In the most significant announcement of the address, the Taoiseach confirmed that he would formally bring the National Emergency to an end under the powers provided by the National Emergencies Act.

The decision follows confirmation that the immediate threat posed by the outbreak has been contained.

The lifting of the emergency marks the beginning of a phased return to normality, although authorities have stressed that the situation will continue to be monitored.

The Taoiseach stated:

"*Today, I am formally ending the national emergency as per my powers within the National Emergencies Act, and have ordered the Irish Defence Forces' slow withdrawal from Baile an Uisce to ensure the perimeter is perfectly safe as withdrawal from the location proceeds.*"

Despite the announcement, military personnel will not immediately leave the affected area.

Instead, the Defence Forces will conduct a gradual withdrawal, maintaining the existing security perimeter while final safety assessments are completed and responsibility is progressively returned to civilian authorities.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565782861561204796/image.png?ex=6ae822ad&is=6ae6d12d&hm=2a703d4c3328017b3c469ea07d1823209c7d8ab69549f48ca727baf84c1b3e9b&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=848)

---

# National Threat Level Set for Reduction

Alongside the termination of the National Emergency, the Government has confirmed its intention to seek a reduction in the National Threat Level.

The current Critical classification, introduced following the initial reports of violent individuals and the suspected outbreak, is expected to be reviewed through a vote of the National Security Council.

The Taoiseach confirmed that he would put forward a proposal to lower the national threat level from **Critical to Moderate**.

The proposed reduction would reflect the successful containment of the immediate threat, while recognising that continued vigilance and monitoring remain necessary.

No immediate return to ordinary security arrangements has been announced pending the Council's decision.



---




# A Message to the Nation

Concluding his address, Taoiseach Seth O’Neill called for national unity as Ireland moves beyond the emergency.

He described the outbreak as an event that had torn apart an entire community, but emphasised that the country's response demonstrated the importance of collective responsibility and national resilience.

"*As we exit this crisis, we leave it in the past with our heads held high, a nation with a renewed purpose of national strength and unity.*"

His remarks bring an end to the immediate Government response that began with the declaration of a National Emergency on 29 October.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565782859015524493/image.png?ex=6ae822ac&is=6ae6d12c&hm=11f653b4554c3f79fa248d3965b47099521823a3683cd65e4ff8a3b51f727331&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=862)

title: Defence Forces Deploy to Baile an Uisce as Troops Move to Contain Outbreak
summary: 28th Infantry Battalion leads operation to restore order
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
# Deployment Authorised by Government

Elements of the 28th Infantry Battalion, supported by units from across 2nd Brigade, have deployed into Baile an Uisce on the direct authority of the Government. The operation follows the Taoiseach’s declaration of a National Emergency and the Government’s decision to authorise the use of the Defence Forces.

Defence Forces command confirmed the deployment was ordered following consultation between Taoiseach Seth O’Neill TD, the Minister for Justice and senior military leadership. Troops have been tasked with containing the outbreak, neutralising hostile individuals and restoring law and order.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565783241720602875/image.png?ex=6ae628c7&is=6ae4d747&hm=856b887935e8ea7528c8ba9d6be50db5397f0ba73fa4e1c2edd29aef1a69afe2&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=834)


---

# Troops on the Ground

Convoys were seen leaving Mulcahy Camp in the early hours, accompanied by armoured vehicles and support elements. The operation is being carried out in support of An Garda Síochána, with the Garda Commissioner’s office coordinating closely with Defence Forces command.

“*This is a Government-directed operation, conducted under lawful authority*,” a Defence Forces spokesperson said. “*Our troops are acting on the orders of the State to protect its citizens.*”

---

# Cordons Established

Soldiers have set up a perimeter around the affected area, with checkpoints and vehicle control points on every major route in and out of Baile an Uisce. Movement within the zone is restricted to military and emergency personnel under Government authority.

Residents outside the cordon have been told to stay indoors, lock their doors and avoid all unnecessary travel.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565781010518638704/image.png?ex=6ae626b3&is=6ae4d533&hm=d3adc53435e5e750f233900a30f4efa9d5aa9f9055b05d1e7db25dca19a03e75&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=853)

---

# Clearing Operations Under Way

Infantry sections are conducting methodical house-to-house clearance, sweeping streets, buildings and open ground sector by sector. Hostile individuals encountered by troops are being engaged and neutralised, and cleared areas are secured and handed over to follow-on units.

CBRN-trained personnel are deployed alongside the infantry to assess contamination risks and manage decontamination of cleared zones. Medical and CBRN teams continue to rotate through the designated training area.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565781012737425578/image.png?ex=6ae626b4&is=6ae4d534&hm=e25a8c2c88877af7bf9710e1906915ca8151d674b4f3c4e6b26efe9e9fc8bf83&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=848)

---

# Civilians and Support

Defence Forces medics and the emergency services have established casualty collection points at the edge of the cordon. Surviving civilians are being screened, treated and moved to secure holding facilities, with the HSE working alongside the military. Engineers are clearing blocked roads and abandoned vehicles to keep supply and evacuation routes open.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565780178548818112/image.png?ex=6ae625ed&is=6ae4d46d&hm=1d475873080b151ea1294dda6a9dbd25a49b3c0f3fec51e1e604fd5e629f5b39&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=851)

---


# Law and Order Returning


Officials report that hostile numbers have been pushed back in several sectors, and Gardaí have begun re-establishing a presence in areas cleared by the military.

“*The Government has given the Defence Forces clear direction and full backing*,” a senior official said. “*The situation is serious, but it is being brought under control*.”

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565781011588063262/image.png?ex=6ae626b3&is=6ae4d533&hm=12de0c0f639384d73af3c53812c3903f0ad1b004d29a0cc93b13b0dd17cdfccc&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=849)


---


# What Happens Next

The National Emergency and the Critical National Threat Level remain in force. The Government has indicated that further deployments are authorised, with additional units on standby at Mulcahy Camp. Updates will follow as operations continue.


![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565780176107999443/image.png?ex=6ae625ec&is=6ae4d46c&hm=74c19f9e2e4e461ccd8b19700cfceb8d31cee80354804b9f9d71480c00ab5a4d&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=865)

title: Images Emerge of President and Senior Government Officials Inside Underground Bunker at Mulcahy Camp
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
# Images Reveal Underground Security Gathering

Images provided by sources appear to show a high-level gathering taking place inside what is believed to be an underground bunker at Mulcahy Camp Headquarters.

Among those reportedly present were the President of Ireland, Taoiseach Seth O’Neill TD, the Garda Commissioner and several senior military and government officials.

The images have raised further questions about the purpose of the gathering, particularly given the ongoing National Emergency and the Critical National Threat Level.



# Officials Identified at the Meeting

Sources have identified several individuals reportedly present inside the underground facility:

President OskarOSullivan – reportedly in attendance.
Taoiseach SethONeill– reportedly present.
Garda Commissioner Daveids
General Officer Commanding, 2nd Brigade SinCrasea 
Deputy Chief of Staff AgentOisin 
Minister for Justice SHADOWDUDE_0PS
Unidentified individual (John Doe) 
![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1486696904074072205/1565524013407666368/b11edfb2-6154-4add-8866-8faddc4df593.png?ex=6ae5375a&is=6ae3e5da&hm=760b02e4f9dcfcbe4050bdebae5037e9d0e3af200263ea59ff8b6d02aa670164&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=865)

Additionally, multiple intelligence officials are believed to have been present, although their identities and specific roles have not been established.



# Why an Underground Bunker?

The apparent use of an underground bunker has raised questions about the nature and importance of the meeting.

The presence of the President, Taoiseach, Garda Commissioner, senior military commanders, the Minister for Justice and intelligence personnel suggests that the gathering involved significant national-level representation.

However, there is currently no confirmed explanation for why the meeting was held underground or whether the location was selected for security, operational or other reasons.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1479924856828203220/1565522951028080731/fc934064-92d4-436a-9b02-ff2a6d3e0d7e.png?ex=6ae5365d&is=6ae3e4dd&hm=66f9a9d511ab0b63b233e72b59b42d878f44c9bbb62600a5c5298006143e1c4a&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1536&height=881)



# Could This Be Connected to the National Emergency?

One possibility being considered is that the gathering could be related to the National Emergency response and the escalating situation in Baile an Uisce.

The substantial representation from national security, military, intelligence and Government leadership has prompted speculation that the meeting may concern the wider emergency.

However, **no direct connection has been established**.

It remains entirely possible that the meeting concerned a separate national security matter.

The identity of the unidentified individual, referred to by sources as John Doe, is also unknown.

title: Project S Opens Its Doors for the Zombie Invasion Event
summary: Baile an Uisce gets its first public showing, and it comes with the undead.
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
For the first time since Group Administration announced it, anyone outside the dev team and the game testers will be able to explore Project S. The temporary opening is tied to the Zombie Invasion event, where players will be chased across the map by hordes of zombies.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1461269591849177233/1480695488364941472/image_8.jpg?ex=6ae51ba2&is=6ae3ca22&hm=effcfab4da2c76e5d2099a11fd83d4a1198008f69c6926fc9508afad4ae2208a&=&format=webp)

Project S was first mentioned on 1 May 2025 in the announcements channel. Details have been thin since then, which has kept the community guessing. The game is called Baile an Uisce, and this will be the first time the public gets to see it for themselves.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1461269591849177233/1492572723686281428/image.png?ex=6ae4cfab&is=6ae37e2b&hm=9c7fd226e45e9a1c951d24ee39735097a54332c5e08959fc4e895348fb989f79&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=2048&height=930)

While taking part in the event, players will also be able to take in parts of the map and the systems that have been built so far. For many, this will be the first real impression of how Baile an Uisce looks, feels and plays.

The timing has also caught the community’s attention. With GTA 6 closing in, some members had joked that it would be released before Project S was ever seen by the public. That is no longer the case, as Project S opens to the public tomorrow, even if only temporarily. It is a limited window and a limited preview, but technically, the community will get Project S before GTA 6.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1461269591849177233/1496998329731776713/image.png?ex=6ae51756&is=6ae3c5d6&hm=ecf19d7b680c095c6f2f97b4724dc7cc92bff2dccca15d3101c44da85511f68b&=&format=webp&quality=lossless)

The opening is temporary, and players interested in seeing Baile an Uisce for themselves are advised to join while the event is live. The event begins tomorrow at 17:00 and runs until 23:00 on Saturday 31st October. The Discord event can be found [here.](https://discord.com/events/721392828588097669/1558679191824891935).
![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1461269591849177233/1498567479646224394/D7D8D2C6-EFF0-4925-BC16-873FCE1513EA.jpg?ex=6ae4ddf9&is=6ae38c79&hm=307de703de685d46181734674c277d74bf3a567e4483169af8aa7a73066f67d6&=&format=webp)

title: Ireland Declares National Emergency as Threat Level Raised to Critical
summary: The Taoiseach, Seth O’Neill TD, has declared a National Emergency after reports of a fast-spreading outbreak of violent, unidentified individuals in Baile an Uisce.
author: SHADOWDUDE_0PS
body:
## What happened?

The Defence Forces received reports on Wednesday night of suspicious individuals in the area. Many assaults on bystanders have been reported, and the number of individuals is said to be growing hour by hour. The Taoiseach chaired a meeting on the situation that night.


---





## Government response

National Emergency: The Taoiseach invoked his powers under the National Emergencies Act.

Threat level: Following a vote by the National Security Committee, the National Threat Level has risen from Moderate to Critical, meaning an attack is highly likely.

Deployment: The Defence Forces and other agencies have been ordered to mobilise to Baile an Uisce to keep the peace and contain the outbreak.

![description](https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/HEfYw-5Abpblj1Nj_gugX4dMBVAKMaGE_OxdgMW3seI/https/pbs.twimg.com/media/HV0gaH1WIAAspt2.jpg?format=webp)




---


## Defence Forces

Óglaigh na hÉireann has raised its Deployment Readiness Level to High. Mulcahy Camp is under lockdown, and the Defence Forces are reviewing operational readiness and contingency arrangements. Troop movements and CBRN activity have increased in the designated training area. Officials say no further information is available for public release.

![description](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1468000244418478232/1565178422190145576/image.png?ex=6ae49e3f&is=6ae34cbf&hm=dbc96d5789fd8b9d0edaf8447a85e6b88752664f87f9591e856db98eb7942437&=&format=webp&quality=lossless)
